caption:
Whose approval quietly runs your life? Only One is meant to own that seat. (Amos 4:1 devotional)

When comfort takes the owner's seat, the weak get crushed; only God belongs there. You don't have to stake your whole heart on anyone but Him.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Who or what sits on the throne of my life where God alone belongs?
